map.输入多个可比案例成交价及各类修正系数，自动计算每个案例的比准价格并加权得到估价对: Enter several comparable transaction prices and adjustment factors; the tool computes an adjusted price for each comparable and weights them into a reference unit price for the subject.
map.📖 查看「市场（比较法）案例修正 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Sales Comparison (Case Adjustment) User Guide"
map.案例修正 = 可比价×因素修正: Case adjustment = comparable price × factor adjustment
map.修正系数（%）：正值表示案例优于估价对象，负值表示劣于估价对象: Adjustment factors (%): a positive value means the comparable is better than the subject, a negative value worse
map.💡 比准价格 = 成交价 ×（1 + 交易情况修正）×（1 + 市场状况修正）×: 💡 Adjusted price = transaction price × (1 + transaction circumstance adjustment) × (1 + market condition adjustment) × (1 + locational adjustment) × (1 + physical adjustment). Sign convention: positive where the comparable is better than the subject, negative where worse.
map.每个修正项均应以估价对象为基准 0%: Every adjustment takes the subject property as the 0% base
map.可比案例与对象应尽可能在同一供需圈、用途一致: Comparables should share the same supply-demand catchment and use as the subject
map.修正幅度一般控制在 ±30% 以内，过大需重新审视可比性: Adjustments are generally kept within ±30%; beyond that, comparability needs review
map.最终比准价应结合估价师经验与市场判断综合确定: The final adjusted price should be settled with the appraiser's experience and market judgement
map.多个可比案例按交易/市场/区域/实物因素修正。: Adjust several comparables for transaction, market, locational and physical factors.
map.加权求估价对象参考单价。: Weight them into a reference unit price for the subject.
map.对比等权与按修正幅度加权的结果。: Compare equal weighting against weighting by adjustment size.
map.案例 A 成交价 8500 元/㎡，交易情况 +2%、市场状况 +1%、区域因素: Comparable A at 8500 yuan/sqm with transaction circumstances +2%, market conditions +1%, locational −1% and physical +3% gives an adjusted price of 8500 × (1.02)(1.01)(0.99)(1.03) ≈ 8930 yuan/sqm.
map.案例 A/B/C 比准价约 8930/9380/9010，等权平均≈9107 元: Adjusted prices for A/B/C are about 8930/9380/9010, an equal-weighted average of ≈ 9107 yuan/sqm; weighting by adjustment size shifts the reference price slightly, so take the mid-point of the range as the valuation basis.
